title: QC-GBL-005 — Newsletter Subscription Management
ac:
Email Template 1 — Subscription Confirmation Email
Triggered automatically when a visitor
successfully subscribes to the newsletter.
Subject (EN): Welcome to Qatar Chamber
Newsletter
Subject (AR): مرحباً بك في النشرة الإخبارية لغرفة
قطر
English Body:
Dear Subscriber,
Thank you for subscribing to the Qatar Chamber
Newsletter.
You will now receive the latest news, updates,
and announcements directly to your inbox.
If you did not request this subscription, or you
wish to unsubscribe at any time, please click the link below:
[ Unsubscribe ]
← unique unsubscribe link per subscriber
Qatar Chamber
www.qatarchamber.com
Arabic Body:
عزيزي المشترك،
شكراً لاشتراكك في النشرة الإخبارية لغرفة قطر.
ستتلقى الآن أحدث الأخبار والتحديثات والإعلانات مباشرةً
في بريدك الإلكتروني.
إذا لم تطلب هذا الاشتراك، أو إذا كنت ترغب في إلغاء
الاشتراك في أي وقت، يرجى النقر على الرابط أدناه:
[ إلغاء الاشتراك ] ← رابط إلغاء اشتراك فريد لكل مشترك
غرفة قطر
www.qatarchamber.com
Business Rules:
- This email is sent immediately and automatically
upon successful subscription.
- The Unsubscribe link is unique per subscriber
and one-click — no login required.
- No admin action is required to trigger this
email.
Email Template 2 — Newsletter Issue Email (Auto-Generated
from CMS)
Triggered when admin sends or schedules a
newsletter issue from the CMS. Content is automatically pulled from
already-published modules.
Subject (EN): Qatar Chamber Newsletter — [Month
Year]
Subject (AR): النشرة الإخبارية لغرفة قطر — [الشهر
السنة]
How Auto-Generation Works:
- The system automatically pulls the latest
published content from the following CMS modules and compiles the newsletter
email:
- Latest News — pulls from the News module
(published news articles)
- Upcoming Events — pulls from the Events module
(upcoming published events)
- Circulars & Announcements — pulls from the
Circulars module (Active / Urgent published circulars)
- Publications & Research — pulls from the
Economic Research / Publications module (latest published reports)
- Admin reviews the auto-compiled content and can
enable or disable any section before sending.
- Admin sends immediately or schedules for a
future date/time.
English Body:
Dear Subscriber,
Here is your latest update from Qatar Chamber.
PUBLICATIONS & RESEARCH
[Report / Publication Title]
[Short description]
Download →
Visit our website: www.qatarchamber.com
To unsubscribe from this newsletter, click here:
[ Unsubscribe ]
Qatar Chamber

عزيزي المشترك،
إليك آخر المستجدات من غرفة قطر.
المنشورات والأبحاث
[عنوان التقرير أو المنشور]

لإلغاء الاشتراك في هذه النشرة، انقر هنا: [ إلغاء
الاشتراك ]

QC-GBL-005 — Newsletter
Subscription Management
FRONTEND — Visitor Subscription &
Unsubscribe
User Story ID
QC-GBL-005 | US-001 | REF: FR-004
Title
Newsletter Subscription Management
— Visitor
As a
public website visitor
I want
to subscribe to the Qatar Chamber
newsletter using my email address and be able to unsubscribe at any time
So that
I can receive relevant updates and
communications, and withdraw my consent whenever I choose
Preconditions:
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and
accessible.
- The newsletter subscription widget is active and
visible on the page.
- The email distribution system is integrated and
operational.
Frontend Workflow — Subscribe:
1. Public Visitor opens the Qatar Chamber
website.
2. Visitor locates the Newsletter Subscription
widget (footer).
3. Visitor enters their email address in the
subscription field.
4. Visitor clicks the Subscribe button.
5. System validates the email format.
6. If valid, system stores the subscriber record
and adds the visitor to the active subscription list.
7. System displays a success message: "You
have successfully subscribed to our newsletter." لقد اشتركت بنجاح في نشرتنا
الإخبارية.
8. If the email is already subscribed, system
displays: "This email is already subscribed." هذا البريد الإلكتروني مشترك
بالفعل.
Frontend Workflow — Unsubscribe:
1. Subscriber receives a Qatar Chamber
newsletter email.
2. Subscriber clicks the Unsubscribe link at the
bottom of the email.
3. Browser opens the Qatar Chamber Unsubscribe
confirmation page.
4. Page displays the subscriber's email and a
confirmation message asking the visitor to confirm unsubscription.
5. Visitor clicks Confirm Unsubscribe.
6. System immediately removes the subscriber
from the active mailing list.
7. System displays: "You have been
successfully unsubscribed. You will no longer receive emails from us." لقد
تم إلغاء اشتراكك بنجاح. لن تتلقى أي رسائل إلكترونية منا بعد الآن.
8. No further newsletter emails are sent to that
address.
Given the visitor accesses the Newsletter Subscription from footer
When the visitor submits the subscription form
Then
- The system shall validate that the email field
is not empty and is in a valid format.
- On successful subscription, the system shall add
the visitor to the active subscription list and display a bilingual success
message.
- If the email is already registered, the system shall
inform the visitor without creating a duplicate record.
Given the subscriber clicks Unsubscribe in a newsletter email
When the subscriber confirms the Un-subscription
Then
- The system shall immediately remove the
subscriber from the active mailing list.
- The system shall display a bilingual unsubscribe
confirmation message.
- The system shall ensure no further newsletter
emails are sent to the unsubscribed address.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If the subscription service is temporarily
unavailable: "Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again
later." الخدمة غير متاحة مؤقتاً. يرجى المحاولة لاحقاً.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the email field is empty: "Email address
is required." البريد الإلكتروني مطلوب.
- If the email format is invalid: "Please
enter a valid email address." يرجى إدخال عنوان بريد إلكتروني صالح.
Post Condition:
- Subscriber is added to the active mailing list
and will receive Qatar Chamber newsletters.
- Unsubscribed users are removed immediately and
will not receive any further communications.

BACKEND — Admin CMS Management
User Story ID
QC-GBL-005 | US-02 | REF: FR-004
Title
Newsletter Subscription Management
— CMS Administration
As a
authorized admin user
(Administrator / Site Content Editor / Site Content Author)
I want
to create, review, approve,
publish, schedule, archive, and send newsletters
So that
Qatar Chamber can communicate
effectively with subscribed users and distribution
Preconditions:
- Admin is logged into Liferay CMS with an
appropriate role (Administrator, Site Content Editor, or Site Content Author).
- Newsletter Management module is accessible in
the CMS.
- Email distribution system is integrated and
operational.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Administrator logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Newsletter Management.
3. Creates a new newsletter
4. Saves the newsletter as Draft.
5. Once approved, the Administrator publishes
immediately or schedules for a future date/time.
6. System sends the newsletter via email to all
active subscribed users based on the configured send mode (Immediate or
Scheduled).
7. Administrator can search and filter newsletters
by keyword, status, date range, audience, or category.
8. System displays a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful action (EN + AR).
Given the admin opens Newsletter Management in the CMS
When the admin creates and publishes a newsletter
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to create
newsletters with bilingual content (EN + AR) following the full lifecycle:
draft → submit for review → approve/reject → publish/schedule → archive.
- The system shall send the newsletter only to
active subscribed users.
- All newsletter emails shall include a clear
Unsubscribe link at the bottom.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic
success toast message after each successful action (EN + AR).
- Unsubscribed users shall be immediately removed
from the active list and shall not receive any further emails.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If the scheduled send date is in the past:
"Scheduled send date must be a future date and time." يجب أن يكون تاريخ
الإرسال المجدول في المستقبل.
Negative Scenarios:
- If mandatory fields are skipped: "{Field
Name} is required." {اسم الحقل} مطلوب.
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access Denied.
You do not have permission to perform this action." تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك
صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post Condition:
- Newsletter is published/sent to all active
subscribers.
